observations: body L1-L10: the end of the list of names begun on p. 313. The Greek οἰκοδεσποτεία, ἀναιρέτης and μοῖρα ἀναιρετική are set as printed; their kappas are printed in the curly form (ϰ). «Nabod» and «Bouché–Leclercq» are letter-spaced; «383–84», «388–90», «Bouché–Leclercq» and «415–19» have long dashes (5.4 pt each). The dash before «Stella» (L7) measures 9.6 pt. The n of «planeta» (L2) prints broken.

body L11-L21: the Greek ἄφεσις εἰς τὰ ἑπόμενα τῶν ζωδίων, ἀναιρέτης, ἑπόμενος τόπος, προηγούμενος τόπος and ἄφεσις εἰς τὰ προηγούμενα τῶν ζωδίων are set as printed; the breathing over the ε of «ἑπόμενα» and «ἑπόμενος» prints like a grave accent, and «εἰς» is printed with a grave accent over its breathing. The i of «Directio» (L11) and the first i of «directio» (L18) print broken.

body L22-L29: the year divided into 13 profectional months and the month into 13 days are as printed: each sign then returns every 13 parts, and the sign of the first month of each year, and of the first day of each month, is that of the whole year, or month, as the text says.

body L30-L35: «Salmasius» and «Bou-», «ché–Leclercq» (L33-L34) are letter-spaced; «264–398», «407–439», «ché–Leclercq» and «411–419» have long dashes (5.0 to 5.3 pt). The date 1648 of Salmasius' book agrees with p. 309.

body L36-L38: the dash after «b)» measures 10.0 pt, the dash between «10» and «pag.» 9.6 pt, and the dash before «Recte» (L38) 10.0 pt. «Bates» is letter-spaced. The commentary b) runs from p. 132, L10 to p. 134, L46 of the translation.
notes_left L1-L7: the Greek Ὁ κλῆρος τῆς τύχης is set as printed: the breathing of the Ὁ prints as a raised point, and its kappa is curly (ϰ). «as-sa-» has a hyphen (3.2 pt).
notes_right L1-L7: the end of Bouché-Leclercq's note, p. 411, note 1.

review_responsibility: Transcribed by Claude from the page images; Greek, Arabic, numbers and signs read on enlarged images. Not reviewed by a person.
